title: Numerical verification suite for "A Margolus–Levitin speed limit for observables: mean energy bounds expectation-value change quadratically"
description:
Manuscript source and the complete, seeded numerical verification suite for a quantum speed limit on observables powered by the mean energy above the ground state.

For every time-independent Hamiltonian H with ground energy E_0, every bounded observable A of spectral spread sigma_A, and every pure or mixed state, T (<H> - E_0) >= C_* Delta^2 / sigma_A^2, where Delta is the change in the expectation value of A and C_* = 1/(8 sin x_*) = 0.172506267461..., with x_* the smallest positive root of tan(x/2) = x. The accompanying no-go theorem shows the optimal state-independent mean-energy exponent of Delta is exactly two, so no linear mean-energy bound of this form exists.

The numerics/ directory reproduces every quoted value in the manuscript from seeded scripts, consolidated in results.json; numerics/README.md maps each number to the script that produces it. The paper/ directory holds the RevTeX 4.2 source and figures.

Licensing is split: code and data under numerics/ are MIT; the manuscript text and figures under paper/ are Copyright 2026 Bryan Nasr, released under CC BY 4.0. See README.md.
